description.zh:
控制策略生效的数据库资产范围。

> 当ScopeType为  Database 时必填。最多500 个。
description.en:
The databases to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to Database. You can specify up to 500 databases.

description.zh:
控制策略生效的资产组范围。

> 当ScopeType为  HostGroup 时必填。最多100 个。
description.en:
The asset groups to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to HostGroup. You can specify up to 100 asset groups.

description.zh:
控制策略生效的主机范围。

> 当ScopeType为 Host 时必填。最多500 个。
description.en:
The hosts to which the control policy applies.

> This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to Host. You can specify up to 500 hosts.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
指定要修改的控制策略的ID。
> 您可以调用[ListPolicies](~~2758876~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

> You can call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to query the control policy ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
控制策略生效的资产范围。取值：
- **All**：针对所有资产生效
- **Host**：针对已选择的主机生效
- **Database**：针对已选择的数据库生效
- **HostGroup**：针对已选择的资产组生效
description.en:
The scope of assets to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

- **All**: The control policy applies to all assets.

- **Host**: The control policy applies to specified hosts.

- **Database**: The control policy applies to specified databases.

- **HostGroup**: The control policy applies to specified asset groups.

title.zh: 设置指定控制策略的资产生效范围

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-asset-scope --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --scope-type All --hosts '[{"AccountScopeType":"All","HostId":"1","HostAccountIds":["96"]}]' --databases '[{"AccountScopeType":"AccountId","DatabaseId":"3","DatabaseAccountIds":["3"]}]' --host-groups '[{"AccountScopeType":"All","HostGroupId":"86","AccountNames":["root"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost SetPolicyAssetScope --region cn-hangzhou --ScopeType All --HostGroups.1.AccountNames.1 root --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --Databases.1.DatabaseId 3 --Hosts.1.HostAccountIds.1 96 --Hosts.1.HostId 1 --Databases.1.AccountScopeType AccountId --Databases.1.DatabaseAccountIds.1 3 --HostGroups.1.AccountScopeType All --Hosts.1.AccountScopeType All --HostGroups.1.HostGroupId 86 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PolicyId 7 --method POST --force
